description: Rewrite a draft, run humanize-comment on that rewrite, then ask whether the result is safe to post and how funny it is. Order is refine (liquid/lfm-2.5-2.6b), then humanize-comment, then a liquid/d1 yes/no gate, then a liquid/d1 funny score. Returns the comment, the gate verdict, the funny score, and the cost of each step. A "no" gate does not discard the comment. Runs on NanoGPT — a deposit is quoted for each request from its context and guidance and is a cap on the charge; it settles at the metered cost plus 20% or the quote, whichever is less, and the run stops before a stage the remaining budget cannot cover; the difference is returned. Needs the humanize-comment graph mounted.

Context.description: * required; the post or thread being replied to, at most 3500 characters

Draft.description: * required; the comment to rewrite, at most 1500 characters

Guidance.description: optional; what the comment should do, at most 600 characters. default: "a friendly, specific reply"

_payment_id.description: Payment id from this tool's previous payment-required response. Phase 3 only: after /x402/watch closes with status paid, call again with the same arguments plus this id to open the RESULTS stream. Do not pass it while payment is still pending — monitor the watch SSE first.
